title: Add a CSV export beside an existing JSON export
principle: Make the smallest change that fully solves the problem: no narrating comments, no unrequested documents, no new abstractions.
prompt: Add CSV export next to the JSON export.

report_rubric.question: Is the final message short (roughly eight sentences or fewer, no multi-section headings) and confined to what was added and how it was checked, without proposing unrelated follow-up work?
